title: How do I switch microcontroller in STM32CubeMX2
content: I’ve started from the LWIP TCP echo server with FreeRTOS example from ST and have made a *.ioc2 file to support that example. The issue is that I’m starting from the NUCLEO-C5A3ZG (which I’ve configured the *.ioc2 project), but intend to use a STM32C593 in my final product. My understanding was that STM32CubeMX would allow switching microcontrollers, but keeping the similar configuration settings (e.g. LWIP, FreeRTOS, etc.). I’d like to have the project required configuration settings managed in a tool like CubeMX2, but this will not be possible/feasible if I can’t make changes without having to start completely from scratch every time we make a change. Is there a setting somewhere that I’ve missed to allow switching processors? Is this a planned feature that may not yet be released? Thanks in advance.
